title: feat(floret): support conversational Quest model preferences
author: Itachi-1824

gist.summary: Floret's model list now includes `paid_only`, and its prompt guidance supports conversational Quest model preferences instead of enforcing Quest selection across an entire request. Explicit agent settings now belong under `metadata`, including `metadata.model`; `metadata.pollen` was removed. A top-level `routing` object now returns a 422 pointing to `metadata` instead of being silently ignored. `@pollinations/sdk` 5.1.0-alpha.14 sends `ChatOptions.routing` as `metadata`, mapping `text` to `metadata.model`. Existing wallet and billing behavior is unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden, Polli wears a tiny gardener's scarf and helps a small Floret flower choose between labeled model seed packets beside a glowing lime green (#ecf874) terminal. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, strictly pixel art and never realistic, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
